```{r}
library(readr)
library(here)
library(abcdutils)

# Replication of abcd_dmdtifp101
abcd_dd("abcd_dmdtifp101")

abcd_dmdtifp101 <-
    read_delim(paste0("~/mnt/wheeler-lab/lab-data/abcd/4.0/evaluated-data/",
                      "abcd_dmdtifp101.txt"))

set.seed(42)

abcd_randomizer <- function(df, n = NULL) {
    data_dictionary <- df[1, ]
    df <- df[-1, ]
    # Select a random subset of rows to begin with
    if (is.null(n)) {
        n <- nrow(df)
    }
    random_rows <- sample(nrow(df), size = n)
    df <- df[random_rows, ]
    # Shuffle all the rows
    for (i in seq_along(df)) {
        df[, i] <- df[sample(nrow(df)), i]
    }
    # Generate fake subject keys and assign them
    subjectchars <- c(toupper(letters), as.character(0:9))
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
        subjectkey <- paste(c("NDAR_INV",
                            sample(subjectchars, size = 8)),
                          collapse = "")
        df[i, c("subjectkey", "src_subject_id")] <- subjectkey
    }
    df <- rbind(data_dictionary, df)
    return(df)
}

mock_abcd_dmdtifp101 <- abcd_randomizer(abcd_dmdtifp101, 2000)

# Export data
write_csv(mock_abcd_dmdtifp101,
          here("data/abcd/mock-data/mock_abcd_dmdtifp101.csv"))

# Test the export
mock_abcd_dmdtifp101 <-
    read_delim(here("data/abcd/mock-data/mock_abcd_dmdtifp101.csv"))

mock_abcd_dmdtifp101

```
